cues.en: Okay. Peter writes, should I be worried about Bear Stearns in terms of liquidity and get my money out of there? No. No. No. Bear Stearns is fine. Do not take your money out. This is real. If there's one takeaway other than a plus 400 somewhere,
cues.zh: 好的。Peter来信问：“我需要担心Bear Stearns的流动性，并把钱取出来吗？”不。不。不。Bear Stearns没问题。千万别把钱取出来。这是认真的。如果说除了某些地方涨了400点之外还有什么关键信息，

cues.en: Bear Stearns is not in trouble. I mean, if anything, they're more likely to be taken over. Don't move your money from Bear. That's just being silly. Don't be silly.
cues.zh: 那就是Bear Stearns根本没陷入困境。我是说，真要有什么事，他们也更有可能是被收购。别把钱从Bear转出来。那纯属犯傻。别犯傻。

cues.en: Okay. Just so you get a sense of what's causing the agony by this point, I know you've been talking about it. It's financials led by Bear Stearns after what essentially is a bailout from the Fed. Bear Stearns shares are down 90% this morning, and it's not just Bear. Pretty much every single bank is plunging in early trade this morning. Lehman, which is very similar to Bear and its reliance on fixed income, is down nearly 30%.
cues.zh: 好。让大家了解一下，到这个时候，究竟是什么让人如此煎熬。你们刚才一直在谈这个问题：美联储实际上出手救助之后，贝尔斯登领跌金融股。今天早盘，贝尔斯登股价暴跌了 90%，而且受影响的不只是贝尔斯登。几乎所有银行的股价今天早盘都在大跌。雷曼和贝尔斯登很相似，都依赖固定收益业务，股价跌了近 30%。

cues.en: You have big names like Goldman Sachs down 8%, Citigroup down 8%. So it is pain across the board
cues.zh: 像高盛下跌了8%，花旗集团也跌了8%，这种巨头都难逃一劫。今天早盘可谓是全线溃败。

cues.en: this morning. And as you know, it all emanates from this... Well,
cues.zh: 正如大家所知，这一切都源于……嗯，

cues.en: the shock this weekend that JPMorgan along with the Fed was going to be bailing out Bear Stearns for $2 a share. This is a stock that recently was trading at 80. Last year, it was trading at a 160.
cues.zh: 周末传出的重磅消息：摩根大通在美联储的支持下，将以每股2美元的价格收购贝尔斯登。而这只股票不久前的交易价还是80美元，去年更是高达160美元。
